source.timeframe: -24h (2026-10-11T11:00Z → 2026-10-12T11:00Z; wider peak-inclusive window per §11 R1, vs ISI-5684's 3h)
source.timeframeNotes: 24h peak-inclusive window on a shared demo playground (wider than ISI-5684's 3h per R1); noise classifier dropped health/metrics scrapes, background polling and static assets; HTTP surface recovered from server-span routes (spans-only; access logs unavailable).
queries: fetch spans,from:-24h | filter request.is_root_span==true | summarize count(),by:{service.name} | sort desc  (G1 app enumeration -> unguard family discovered)

fetch spans,from:-24h | filter request.is_root_span==true and startsWith(service.name,'unguard') | summarize count(),by:{service.name,span.name}  (unguard entry-route surface; front-end=unguard-frontend)
fetch logs,from:-24h | filter k8s.container.name=='istio-proxy' | summarize count()  (access-log probe -> unavailable, spans-only)

fetch spans,from:-24h | filter span.kind=='server' and service.name=='unguard-frontend' | summarize percentile(duration,50/95/99),avg(duration),count(),countIf(is_failed)  (Reader/front-end server baseline: p50 22.4ms p95 3953.8ms p99 6649.1ms, 0 fail)
fetch spans,from:-24h | filter request.is_root_span==true and service.name=='unguard-frontend' | summarize countDistinctExact(trace.id)  (638,129 front-end root traces)

fetch spans,from:-24h | filter (service.name=='unguard-microblog-service' and span.name=='POST /post') or (service.name=='unguard-like-service' and span.kind=='server' and span.name=='POST') | summarize countDistinctApprox(trace.id)  (engager/write reach = 8,666 traces)

fetch spans,from:-24h | filter service.name=='unguard-microblog-service' and span.name=='POST /post' | summarize percentile(duration,50/95/99),count(),countIf(is_failed)  (Engager defining step: p50 27.5ms p95 84.9ms p99 161.4ms)
fetch spans,from:-24h | filter request.is_root_span==true and service.name=='unguard-frontend' | makeTimeseries count(),interval:1m  (arrival curve, 1439 bins, CoV 0.182 -> ramped)
fetch spans,from:-24h | filter span.kind=='server' and service.name=='unguard-frontend' | summarize sum(duration),count()  (busy-integral 1.183e15 ns -> concurrency 13.69; rate 20.50 tps)

journeys.description: Reader — browses timeline, profiles & ads (read-only); reconstructed from the trace span-tree over a 24h window. Folds entry ops: reader_browse_flow.
Engager — authenticated user posts / likes content (write path); reconstructed from the trace span-tree over a 24h window. Folds entry ops: engager_write_flow.
